note: Both sets cover the same four Table 6-2 properties plus the damping-ratio sentence, with heavy duplication and essentially identical claim content. Each contains the same core errors: an invented radius-type property bound to the 38.234 m CM value (A: 'radius of gyration', B: 'radius around Tower Centerline'), a damping claim whose condition inverts the text (says 'rotor-nacelle assembly mass present' where the source says 'without'), a spurious 'Height above Ground = 87.6 m' condition on the damping ratio, and a misbound 'tower centerline height' claim whose quote is about overall tower height. Neither set has a correct claim the other lacks, and their error counts are effectively equal.
